description: Must-reject. A single 0x00 length-prefix byte for the TrustAnchorID (log id) field: below the draft's opaque<1..2^8-1> minimum of 1 byte. Not derived from a serializer call (no valid Checkpoint is this short) — this is the exact byte sequence crates/mtc/src/checkpoint/mod.rs's own parse_rejects_empty_trust_anchor_id unit test already asserts is correct, reused rather than invented.
